Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: AutoTech Solutions Inc. specializes in the retail and wholesale distribution of automotive parts and accessories, including batteries, filters, brakes, and electronic components. Our operations focus on providing high-quality products to local auto repair shops and individual customers. We ensure compliance with all safety regulations and maintain a secure, well-organized facility, minimizing risks associated with theft and accidents. Our team is trained in safety protocols, and we regularly conduct inventory audits to uphold high operational standards.
